unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support with the request id below.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the page has moved.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Nothing was sent. Check the connection and try again.

forbidden.title: This part is not open to your role
forbidden.body: The rest of the page still works. Ask an administrator if you need it for your work.
